comment_purpose: One Mac account's own facts for the Git Crafter rules, with placeholders only. Copy it to code-os/account.json in the account's private overlay folder and fill it in; claude_os_sync.py apply user-claude --yes --overlay DIR installs it as ~/.claude/code-os/account.json. rules/compute.md, rules/compute-detail.md and rules/keys.md read these fields, and skills/merging/orchestrating.md reads delegate. Names, paths and command shapes only, never a key value (rules/keys.md). Every field takes a source: where the value was read, or the owner's dated words.

machine.model: <model, chip and memory, and how they were read>
machine.limits: <what this machine cannot do, such as GPU rendering>
machine.admin: <the macOS account that installs and upgrades shared tools>
machine.source: <where the model and limits were read>

keys.policy: <file in the checkout whose naming and rotation rules win>
keys.naming: <how a key is named, or an object of provider, keychain, variable and rules>
keys.use: <command shape that runs a child with one key, e.g. keys exec <software>:<purpose> -- <command>>
keys.use_note: <what the tool refuses or redacts, optional>
owner_runs: <command only the owner runs, such as add, rotate or remove>

compute.options: ~/<folder that lists this account's compute lanes>
included: <a free tier or included credit, and the stop at its limit>
bulk_models: <a free model lane for bulk text work>
compute.deploys: <the host's build that deploys on merge>

comfy.standing_yes: <what runs without a yes per run, or none>
comfy.standing_yes_source: <the owner's dated words granting it, and where they were recorded>
comfy.stop: <where the guard pauses, e.g. 90% of the cycle's plan credits>
comfy.guard: <command that answers go with exit 1, e.g. usage-guard check comfy-cloud>
comfy.guard_source: <the owner's dated words on the guard>
comfy.desktop_ended: <date local Comfy Desktop stopped running here, or none>

ci.pool: <the org whose Actions minutes the pool uses>
ci.budget: <the hard stop, e.g. a $0 Actions budget with prevent_further_usage>
ci.overflow: <the lane that takes overflow and the stop it needs first, or none>

delegate.comment: This account's installed routes for the Delegating table in skills/merging/orchestrating.md. Each route names how to call it and one metric the pages read.

review.use: <agent, plugin or connector, and how to call it>

bulk_text.use: <a free model lane for bulk text work, the guard check before it, and how the commit credits the model>

design_to_code.use: <the skill or connector that turns a design into code>

never.what: <tools or models this account never routes work to>
